subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Should public cron config expose restart catch-up control as raw max/stagger knobs, an explicit skip/freshness policy, or no new public config?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the current internal max/stagger semantics do not provide the requested disable behavior and new cron config keys become a long-lived compatibility contract.

options.title: Design explicit missed-run policy
options.body: Add a global or per-job skip/freshness policy that preserves current defaults but lets user-facing jobs skip stale restart catch-up.

options.title: Expose narrow global knobs
options.body: Publish max/stagger controls only after defining zero-limit behavior and documenting that stagger controls rate pressure rather than duplicate relevance.

options.title: Keep controls internal
options.body: Decline new config for now and document current restart catch-up behavior and mitigations while narrower bugs are fixed separately.

recommendation.title: Design explicit missed-run policy
recommendation.body: Add a global or per-job skip/freshness policy that preserves current defaults but lets user-facing jobs skip stale restart catch-up.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the original internal restart catch-up controls and is the strongest available owner for the public config/product decision.
